Privacy.title: Privacy and data
Privacy.description: We use optional analytics to understand portfolio usage and optional diagnostics to fix failures. Nothing is sent before you choose.
Privacy.privacySignal: Your browser signaled a privacy preference. Optional categories remain disabled until you make an affirmative choice.

analytics.title: Usage analytics
analytics.description: Measures permitted views and interactions without forms or personal identification.

diagnostics.title: Error diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Sends sanitized technical failures to help fix the site.

Privacy.saveError: Your choice could not be saved. No optional data was enabled.

PrivacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
PrivacyNotice.intro: This portfolio collects optional data only after your consent. Refusing does not limit access to the site.

controller.title: Controller
controller.description: Bruno Costa is responsible for the data-processing decisions made for this portfolio.

data.title: Data and purpose
data.description: Analytics records normalized pages, language, and permitted interactions. Diagnostics records sanitized technical failures. We do not send form values, email, name, full URLs, query strings, visitor IP addresses, User-Agent values, advertising data, or fingerprints.

providers.title: Processors
providers.description: Consented analytics events are processed by <google>Google Analytics</google>. Consented diagnostics are processed by <sentry>Sentry</sentry>.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: GA4 event data must remain configured for two months. Diagnostics follow the shortest retention available under the active Sentry plan.

control.title: Your choices
control.description: You can reject, select categories, or withdraw permission at any time through Privacy settings in the footer. Withdrawal stops new transmissions and removes local analytics identifiers.
